items.title: Read Your Own Writes Off the Primary: WAIT FOR Measured
items.blurb: WAIT FOR in PostgreSQL 19 lets a reader block until the replica has replayed a specific LSN. Measured against sticky routing, sleeps, and synchronous commit, on a replica that misses the write 99% of the time.
